metadata.description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for SceneView — the open-source 3D & AR SDK for Android (Jetpack Compose) and the web.

plugins.name: sceneview
plugins.description: Build 3D and AR apps with SceneView: Jetpack Compose + Filament + ARCore on Android, and Filament.js + WebXR on the web. Two skills: sceneview (Android) and sceneview-web.

plugins.name: sceneview-contrib
plugins.description: For contributors to the sceneview/sceneview repository only: review, test, version-bump and release commands, plus cross-platform parity reminder hooks.
